en-US.title: MenoCompass
en-US.subtitle: Menopause symptom tracker
en-US.description:
Track menopause symptoms, treatment context, medications, lab results, sleep, movement, and notes in one private place.

MenoCompass is offline-first: your health entries remain on your device. There is no account, advertising, analytics, or third-party tracking.

KEY FEATURES
• Fast daily symptom check-ins
• Medication schedules and dose tracking
• Lab result history
• Trends across symptoms, sleep, and activity
• Clinician-friendly printable reports
• Evidence-graded educational reference library
• Local backup and restore

MenoCompass provides general health education and self-tracking. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace care from a qualified clinician.
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial TestFlight release with private symptom tracking, medication schedules, lab results, trends, and clinician reports.
